name: tradecat-public
repo_role: Hermes/Agent-facing TradeCat skill package and local contract layer; users install this repo as tradecat-public so their local Hermes can load SKILL.md and agents/manifest.json.

root_responsibilities: Thin validation and command wrappers under root scripts/
project_responsibilities: TradeCat public cache, CLI, TUI, and zero-install request implementation
Public-readonly paper/watch, replay/backtest, ledger, risk, reports, contracts, resources, tests, and project scripts
skill_package_governance.safety_boundary: Root Skill wrapper never grants Binance credentials, signed requests, account reads, or real orders; implementation remains public-readonly plus paper/watch under project/.

agent_role_profiles.activation: Use only as an Agent/Hermes soft prompt for public-readonly market research and paper/watch thesis generation.
agent_role_profiles.safety_boundary: Soft role configuration only; deterministic context-audit, risk, and paper ledger gates remain authoritative.

command_risk_classes.local_readonly: Reads local tracked files, settings, or cache metadata only.
command_risk_classes.network_readonly: Reads public network resources without writing local cache.
command_risk_classes.local_cache_write: Writes only local TradeCat cache, settings, or diagnostics.
command_risk_classes.background_long_running: Starts or supervises a long-running local watcher.
command_risk_classes.install_or_uninstall: Changes user installation paths, launchers, virtual environments, or shell PATH guidance.
command_risk_classes.security_or_supply_chain: Runs scanners or dependency audit tools; may download tool metadata.
command_risk_classes.paper_runtime_write: Writes local paper-trading runtime state, ledger, JSONL archives, or paper service PID/log files; never places real orders.

exit_codes.1: local cache has no analyzable data or runtime failure
local cache has no feature candidates or runtime failure
watch process is not running; payload includes state and error object

validation_commands.purpose: Validate manifest, JSON schemas, exit codes, and zero-install request fallback without live data writes.
Run project tests, lint, contract checks, and shell syntax.
Validate dataset consumption semantics against the bundled registry.
Validate self-contained Binance Agent market-context resource provenance, hashes, and safety boundaries.
Scan tracked files or selected history for leaked secrets.
Audit Python dependencies with pinned tooling.

high_risk_commands.reason: Creates or updates user app checkout, virtualenv, launchers, and optional PATH guidance.
Windows installer mutates user install paths and launchers.
Spawns a watcher process; success means process spawn, not remote data health.
Reports watcher status if running or starts a missing watcher; success means supervision action completed, not remote data health.
Deletes local historical snapshots according to retention arguments.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The requested dataset_key is not in the bundled registry.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh datasets --json and use one of the advertised keys.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The public Google Sheets or registry request timed out.
known_failure_modes.repair: Retry with --timeout 10 or use cached local data when available.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The remote endpoint returned a non-success HTTP status.
known_failure_modes.repair: Retry later for 429/5xx; check public sheet permissions for 4xx.

known_failure_modes.meaning: Local cache has been initialized but no active dataset has a latest projection yet.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh doctor --sync --timeout 10 after checking network.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The local cache has no rows for the analysis input datasets.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh doctor --sync --timeout 10 or sync-all --json before analyze.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The analyze command received an invalid window or limit argument.
known_failure_modes.repair: Use --window latest or an Nh/Nd/Nw value, and keep --limit greater than 0.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The local cache has no symbol candidates that can be normalized into feature facts.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh doctor --sync --timeout 10 or ensure anomaly_panel has entity-key rows.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The features command received an invalid window or limit argument.
known_failure_modes.repair: Use --window latest or an Nh/Nd/Nw value, and keep --limit greater than 0.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The watcher lifecycle status command could not find a running watcher process.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run bash project/scripts/start.sh start --json, then verify remote data health with probe --json --no-write.

known_failure_modes.meaning: A local setting or environment variable is invalid.
known_failure_modes.repair: Check the reported message, unset the bad environment variable, or repair local settings.

known_failure_modes.meaning: A local command failed unexpectedly after argument validation.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run tradecat doctor --verbose or doctor --bundle - and inspect the stable error object.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The autonomous paper run-loop service PID is missing or not alive.
known_failure_modes.repair: Run bash project/scripts/start-auto-paper.sh start --json and then inspect paper-report/log paths.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The latest public Sheet event is older than the configured max_event_age_seconds or cannot be parsed.
known_failure_modes.repair: Wait for a fresh signal_flow/anomaly_panel row or raise --max-event-age-seconds for diagnostic paper tests only.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The supplied Agent market-context file could not be read or parsed as JSON.
known_failure_modes.repair: Check the --input path, ensure it is a local JSON object, and retry context-audit before run-context.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The supplied Agent market context contains credential-like keys or values.
known_failure_modes.repair: Remove API keys, secrets, signatures, listen keys, private keys, and account material; use only public/read-only market data.

known_failure_modes.meaning: A market_data item is marked signed or requires a signature.
known_failure_modes.repair: Replace it with a public GET endpoint where requires_signature=false and signed=false.

known_failure_modes.meaning: A market_data endpoint is outside the public/read-only family allowlist.
known_failure_modes.repair: Use only the families and endpoints advertised by tradecat-auto-agent-market-context.schema.json and context-audit.

known_failure_modes.meaning: The supplied Agent context contains real account, balance, position, order, order-id, or user-trade state.
known_failure_modes.repair: Remove real exchange account/order state and use only paper_account_state derived from the local TradeCat paper ledger.

known_failure_modes.meaning: Mainnet execution is deliberately rejected by the deterministic risk gate.
known_failure_modes.repair: Use paper/watch until explicit testnet/mainnet execution gates are implemented and authorized.

safe_order_of_operations: read agents/manifest.json
read references/hermes-agent-guide.md when the task involves local Hermes skill installation, development/production boundary, or Agent-supplied market context
when installed under ~/.hermes/skills/tradecat-public, load this repo as the Hermes skill and use agents/manifest.json as the machine entrypoint
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh status --json
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh datasets --json
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh path signal_flow --json

for Agent soft decisions, load bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto soft-layer --json before composing market context or trade thesis prompts; use role_profiles[].id=discretionary_futures_trader when a paper-only trader persona is needed
derive prompt-safe account/order context only from auto paper-report paper_account_state; never from Binance account/order endpoints
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto daily-report --json or alert-payload --kind daily --json for reporting without trading side effects
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto health-report --json to inspect heartbeat/ledger/archive/audit health before or after starting the service
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto audit-journal --json to inspect local paper/watch audit-chain state
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh analyze --json when local cache is already populated
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh features --json when per-symbol fact bundles are needed
if only inspecting public data, prefer python3 project/scripts/request.py signal_flow --format json --limit 5
only write local cache when needed with bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh sync signal_flow --json --timeout 10
for operator-managed legacy paper testing, run bash project/scripts/start-auto-paper.sh ops-check --json and status --json before starting a new service
run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto paper-report --json to inspect paper ledger state

for Agent-supplied Binance market context, load bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto soft-layer --json, let Agent/Hermes gather only public/read-only data, write tradecat_auto.agent_market_context.v1, run bash scripts/run-tradecat.sh auto context-audit --input <context.json> --json, then run run-context; this is the canonical paper/watch path

treat auto market-universe/probe-public/run-once/run-loop/start-auto-paper as legacy/operator diagnostics unless a task explicitly asks for TradeCat's own public network probe; they are not the Agent market-context input surface
start continuous legacy paper testing only with bash project/scripts/start-auto-paper.sh start --json; stop it with the matching stop command
before delivery run bash scripts/agent-smoke.sh and the validation_commands that match the change scope

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Summarize persistent paper ledger state, open/closed positions, fills, and equity curve tail.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Local paper ledger reporting only; no Binance credentials, signed requests, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Fetch and summarize the Binance USDⓈ-M USDT perpetual public symbol universe.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Public Binance market metadata only; no account endpoints and no credentials.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Probe TradeCat public Sheet rows plus Binance public market bundle for one selected symbol.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Public/read-only probe; never places orders or reads account state.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Build one deterministic public-readonly paper/watch analysis report from Sheet signals and Binance public data.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Single-cycle paper/watch report only; mainnet execution is rejected by deterministic risk gates.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Run one safe service cycle with event freshness/dedupe, paper ledger update, and optional JSONL archive.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Writes only local paper runtime state/ledger/archive; execution remains paper/watch and order-free.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Report, start, or stop the local autonomous paper run-loop process managed by start-auto-paper.sh.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Manages only a local paper daemon PID/log/runtime directory; no real exchange execution.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Preflight long-running auto-paper operations dependencies, path isolation, OS limits, credential env names, and systemd hardening settings.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Local preflight only; reports credential-like environment variable names but never reads secret values or touches Binance private APIs.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Audit an Agent/Hermes-supplied market context JSON file against public/read-only allowlists, provenance, and credential/order prohibitions.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Validation-only audit; rejects signed, account, credential-like, and order endpoints before paper/watch use.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Compute deterministic paper backtest metrics from a local paper ledger.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Local paper ledger metrics only; no network, credentials, or real exchange execution.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Build a reproducible replay/backtest report from local service-cycle JSONL archives and paper ledger state.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Reads only local paper/watch archive and ledger files; no credentials, signed requests, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Reconstruct per-cycle paper/watch decision traces and error-code aggregation from local service-cycle archive and optional audit journal metadata.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Reads only local paper/watch archive and optional audit journal summary; no network, credentials, signed requests, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Aggregate paper/watch decision quality metrics: Agent input completeness, error-code causes, paper outcomes, and non-advisory engineering notes.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Local replay metrics only; not investment advice and never a real execution instruction.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Return self-contained Agent/Hermes prompt templates, configurable role profiles, endpoint policy, and soft thesis contract resources for public-readonly paper research.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Public/read-only plus paper/watch contract only; no Binance credentials, signed requests, real account reads, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Soft Agent/Hermes research-thesis output contract; deterministic TradeCat audit/risk/paper gates remain authoritative.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Public/read-only plus paper/watch contract only; no Binance credentials, signed requests, real account reads, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Prompt-safe paper account state derived only from the local TradeCat paper ledger, never Binance account/order endpoints.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Public/read-only plus paper/watch contract only; no Binance credentials, signed requests, real account reads, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Report the local paper ledger result of applying one explicit Agent position-management thesis.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Writes only local paper/watch ledger and audit-journal evidence; close/adjust are paper-only and add/reduce remain fail-closed until explicit partial-fill contracts exist.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Summarize local SQLite paper/watch audit journal counts and checksum-chain integrity.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Reads only local paper/watch audit journal metadata; no network, credentials, signed requests, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Record one service cycle, config snapshot, risk decision, paper orders, and paper fills into the local SQLite audit journal.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Writes only local SQLite paper/watch audit records and rejects real-order or signed/account payloads.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Report paper/watch production heartbeat, ledger health, cycle archive health, and audit journal chain status.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Reads only local paper/watch runtime files and audit journal; no Binance credentials, account state, signed requests, or real orders.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Build daily paper/watch report from local paper ledger and cycle archive.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Reads only local paper ledger and JSONL archive to summarize paper positions/fills; no real exchange execution.

automation_output_contracts.purpose: Build Telegram-friendly plain-text alerts from health or daily paper/watch reports.
automation_output_contracts.safety_boundary: Formats local paper/watch report text only; delivery is handled outside this contract and no trading side effect occurs.

reference_resources.purpose: Local self-contained Binance skill/API reference snapshot for Agent/Hermes-supplied market context provenance and endpoint classification.
reference_resources.safety_boundary: Reference only: public/read-only Binance market context may be used later through explicit contracts; signed/account/order examples in upstream snapshots are not runtime tools.

reference_resources.purpose: Self-contained soft endpoint policy for Agent market-context prompts; hard safety gates remain in code.
reference_resources.safety_boundary: Policy permits only public/read-only market data families and enumerates hard-forbidden account/order categories.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Top-level Hermes/Agent autonomous research-loop envelope that links a TradeCat signal, public/read-only Binance tool plan/results, optional market context, optional trade thesis, risk notes, and next_action.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Research-cycle contract only; TradeCat still requires context-audit and explicit Agent thesis sizing/exits before any paper ledger mutation.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Explicit file/stdin-style contract for Agent/Hermes-supplied public/read-only Binance market context.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Input contract only; TradeCat audits allowlisted public market families before paper/watch processing.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Optional Agent/Hermes soft research thesis for paper/watch review; not a real order instruction.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Soft thesis only; deterministic TradeCat paper/risk gates decide all ledger mutations and reject real-order semantics.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Local operator/Agent delegation profile that lets TradeCat synthesize missing paper/watch sizing and exit fields for autonomous paper research loops.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Paper autonomy profile may only authorize local paper/watch ledger intents; it must not contain Binance keys, signed requests, account state reads, or real-order semantics.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Agent/Hermes supplied paper/watch position-management thesis for local TradeCat paper ledger hold/noop, close, exit adjustment, add, or reduce intents.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Position management thesis may update only the local paper/watch ledger after explicit Agent authorization; it is never a Binance order, account, leverage, or margin mutation request.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Operator/Agent supplied paper/watch portfolio risk policy containing rejection limits only: drawdown, daily loss, exposure, cooldown, confidence, abnormal-move halt, and kill switch.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Risk policy never supplies order sizing, leverage, stop loss, take profit, or real execution instructions; it only constrains local paper/watch decisions.

automation_input_contracts.purpose: Sanitized paper/watch candidate intent for a future private executor to review; not a real order and never credential-bearing.
automation_input_contracts.safety_boundary: Public handoff candidate only; private executor must re-check account state, risk, permissions, and operator approval outside this repository.
